name: ICNA Relief
mission: ICNA Relief USA seeks to alleviate human suffering by providing caring and compassionate service to victims of adversities and survivors of disasters. ICNA Relief USA strives to build healthy communities, strengthen families and create opportunities for those in despair while maintaining dignity and advocating for basic human needs.

dimension_explanations.alignment: ICNA Relief is highly aligned with the needs of Muslim donors as a zakat-eligible organization [2]. It has a long track record of serving underserved populations through its refugee and transitional housing programs [14]. While it claims to serve ten geographic areas, it does not report specific foreign grants on its tax filings [4].
dimension_explanations.impact: The charity operates with high efficiency, spending $49.91 per beneficiary to deliver aid [14]. In FY2024, it maintained 4.6 months of working capital, ensuring it can continue services during financial gaps [4]. Its Cash-Adjusted Program Expense Ratio (gifts-in-kind excluded) of 88.5% shows that most funds go directly to programs like disaster relief and women's housing [1][4].

rich_narrative.summary: ICNA Relief USA provides domestic humanitarian aid, disaster recovery, and social services across the United States. In FY2024, the organization reported <cite id="4">total revenue of $58,008,025</cite> to support vulnerable populations including refugees, disaster survivors, and low-income families. The charity holds <cite id="1">an overall score of 96.5/100 from Charity Navigator</cite>, reflecting strong governance and financial health. In FY2024, ICNA Relief maintained a <cite id="4">program expense ratio of 88.5%</cite>, with a cash-adjusted program expense ratio of 88.5% after adjusting for noncash gifts. The organization also spent <cite id="1">only $0.04 to raise every $1</cite> in fundraising expenses. ICNA Relief serves over one million beneficiaries nationwide through local food pantries, transitional housing, free health clinics, and disaster response teams.
